newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-DESBIENS WINS AS OUTSCHAKOV STRIPPED OF FIRST PLACE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-DESBIENS WINS AS OUTSCHAKOV STRIPPED OF FIRST PLACE.

text.p: Laurent Desbiens of France won the 11th stage of the Tour de France after Ukrainian Sergei Outschakov, who finished first, was relegated to third for not holding his line.
An angry and disappointed Outschakov, claiming he was far enough ahead of Desbiens to invalidate such a ruling, said: "My advantage was good."
But television replays showed the Ukrainian edging Desbiens, who was just behind him, towards the side barriers metres from the line in the final sprint of the 192-km stage from Andorra.
Italian Carlo Finco was given second place. The trio finished 18 seconds ahead of the chasing pack.
Jan Ullrich of Germany retained the overall leader's yellow jersey after snatching it in commanding fashion on the 10th-stage final ascent in Andorra on Tuesday.
